note: Selected subset of Annex A controls relevant to a cloud-native SaaS company. Control numbers and titles follow ISO/IEC 27001:2022; the 'requirement' field is a short paraphrase written for this project, not ISO text.

controls.title: Policies for information security
controls.requirement: An information security policy and topic-specific policies are defined, approved by management, published and reviewed.

controls.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.requirement: An inventory of information and associated assets, with owners, is developed and maintained.

controls.title: Access control
controls.requirement: Rules to control physical and logical access are established based on business and security requirements.

controls.title: Authentication information
controls.requirement: Allocation and management of authentication information (e.g. passwords, keys) is controlled.

controls.title: Access rights
controls.requirement: Access rights are provisioned, reviewed, modified and removed according to policy.

controls.title: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.requirement: Processes manage the security risks associated with suppliers' products and services.

controls.title: Information security for use of cloud services
controls.requirement: Acquisition, use, management and exit from cloud services follow defined security requirements.

controls.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
controls.requirement: Incident management processes, roles and responsibilities are defined and communicated.

controls.title: Response to information security incidents
controls.requirement: Incidents are responded to according to documented procedures.

controls.title: Information security during disruption
controls.requirement: Information security is maintained at an appropriate level during disruption.

controls.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
controls.requirement: ICT readiness is planned, implemented, maintained and tested against continuity objectives.

controls.title: Privacy and protection of PII
controls.requirement: Requirements for privacy and protection of personal data are identified and met.

controls.title: Information security awareness, education and training
controls.requirement: Personnel receive appropriate security awareness, education and training.

controls.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
controls.requirement: Security responsibilities that remain valid after termination or change are defined and enforced.

controls.title: User endpoint devices
controls.requirement: Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user endpoint devices is protected.

controls.title: Privileged access rights
controls.requirement: Allocation and use of privileged access rights is restricted and managed.

controls.title: Secure authentication
controls.requirement: Secure authentication technologies and procedures are implemented (e.g. multi-factor authentication).

controls.title: Protection against malware
controls.requirement: Protection against malware is implemented and supported by user awareness.

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.requirement: Information about technical vulnerabilities is obtained, exposure evaluated and appropriate measures taken.

controls.title: Configuration management
controls.requirement: Configurations, including security configurations, are established, documented, monitored and reviewed.

controls.title: Information backup
controls.requirement: Backup copies are maintained and regularly tested according to a backup policy.

controls.title: Logging
controls.requirement: Logs recording activities, exceptions and security events are produced, stored, protected and analysed.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.requirement: Networks, systems and applications are monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate action is taken.

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.requirement: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including key management, are defined and implemented.

controls.title: Secure development life cycle
controls.requirement: Rules for the secure development of software and systems are established and applied.

controls.title: Secure coding
controls.requirement: Secure coding principles are applied to software development.

controls.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
controls.requirement: Security testing processes are defined and implemented in the development life cycle.
